raw:
@q query
  select ?p
  rank highest ?s
  where all
    match
      relation "be a partner in"
      role subject ?p
      role object "Radcliffe Mbeki LLP"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "work at"
      role subject ?p
      role location "Bucharest"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be senior"
      role subject ?p
      role object ?s
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
